source: S3-B adversarial vectors — authored INDEPENDENTLY from the bundle-format spec by fixtures/author-adversarial.py (Python; shares no code with generate-fixtures.mjs). Synthetic values only: leaves/txids derive from sha256('s3adv-*') seeds; the signature vectors embed the PROOF-08 throwaway TEST key (never a production key). No PII, no real org/user identifiers.

fixtures.name: adv-valid-even-tree-pass
fixtures.description: Independently authored (Python, spec-derived) fully valid vector: 4-leaf app tree, canonical ARKV||root OP_RETURN, real header + receipt inclusion proof at pos 1. Must VERIFY — proves the spec derivation and the verifier agree.

fixtures.name: adv-valid-metadata-suffix-pass
fixtures.description: Valid vector whose on-chain push carries the OPTIONAL 8-byte metadata suffix (ARKV||root||meta, 44 bytes). The root is still read at fixed offset [4,36) — must VERIFY.

fixtures.name: adv-tampered-fingerprint-byte
fixtures.description: One byte of the fingerprint flipped (byte 7 XOR 0x01); branch + root untouched. Recompute must fail: MERKLE_MISMATCH.

fixtures.name: adv-app-sibling-order-swapped
fixtures.description: The two app-branch entries are presented in the wrong level order (hashes + positions intact). Recompute walks the wrong concatenation sequence: MERKLE_MISMATCH.

fixtures.name: adv-leaf-index-off-by-one-selfpair
fixtures.description: 3-leaf tree, rightmost leaf (real index 2) legitimately self-pairs — but the packet declares merkle_index 1 (off by one). At index 1 of a 3-wide level the self-pair is NOT a legitimate duplication: FORGED_SELF_PAIR.

fixtures.name: adv-block-proof-pos-off-by-one
fixtures.description: Independent-node inclusion proof carries pos 2 instead of the true 1 (siblings unchanged), so the fold takes the wrong side at level 0 and the recomputed receipt root diverges from the header: ROOT_NOT_IN_HEADER.

fixtures.name: adv-block-proof-sibling-order-swapped
fixtures.description: Independent-node inclusion-proof sibling list reversed (bottom-up order violated). The fold hashes levels in the wrong sequence: ROOT_NOT_IN_HEADER.

fixtures.name: adv-truncated-header-79-bytes
fixtures.description: The independent node serves a 79-byte (158-hex) header. The 80-byte rule must reject it before any timestamp/merkleroot is read: HEADER_INVALID.

fixtures.name: adv-wrong-marker-arkx
fixtures.description: The push reads 'ARKX'||root — not the canonical 4-byte ASCII 'ARKV' marker. No canonical anchor output exists: NO_ANCHOR_OUTPUT.

fixtures.name: adv-marker-not-at-offset
fixtures.description: The push contains 0x00 then ARKV||root — the marker exists as a SUBSTRING but not at byte offset 0. A substring-matching decoder would accept this forgery; the fixed-offset rule must reject: NO_ANCHOR_OUTPUT.

fixtures.name: adv-height-mismatch
fixtures.description: The independent node reports the receipt at height 901001 while the packet claims 901000: HEIGHT_MISMATCH.

fixtures.name: adv-reorg-hash-mismatch
fixtures.description: The independent height→hash index resolves the stated height to a different hash than the receipt claims (reorg signal): BLOCK_HASH_MISMATCH.

fixtures.name: adv-receipt-not-found
fixtures.description: The independent node has never seen the claimed receipt id (404 on /tx). Nothing on chain corroborates the packet: TX_NOT_FOUND.

fixtures.name: adv-receipt-unconfirmed
fixtures.description: The independent node serves the receipt but reports it unconfirmed (not in any block): NOT_IN_BLOCK.

fixtures.name: adv-unsupported-schema-version
fixtures.description: proof_schema_version 99 — the verifier only understands v1 and must refuse to interpret rather than guess: UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION.

fixtures.name: adv-malformed-fingerprint
fixtures.description: Fingerprint is 63 hex chars (not a 32-byte value). Format guard must refuse before any walk: MALFORMED_BUNDLE.

fixtures.name: adv-empty-branch-root-mismatch
fixtures.description: Empty inclusion branch (single-leaf claim) but the root does not equal the fingerprint — nothing connects them: EMPTY_BRANCH_UNVERIFIABLE.

fixtures.name: adv-valid-signed-bundle
fixtures.description: PROOF-08 corpus signed bundle verified against its published (throwaway TEST) key set, resolved by signing_key_id. Recompute passes and the issuer signature verifies: VERIFIED.

fixtures.name: adv-forged-signature
fixtures.description: The corpus bundle with signature.value replaced by the corpus-documented bad_signature_value (first byte perturbed). The Ed25519 check must fail and, because a signature check was explicitly requested, the verdict fails closed: SIG_INVALID.

fixtures.name: adv-unknown-signing-key-id
fixtures.description: The bundle's signing_key_id is not present in the published key set (the signature bytes themselves are the valid ones — only the key identity is unresolvable). Must fail closed without guessing a key: DID_UNRESOLVED.
